title: The Double Contact
premise: Hazel Zhou, a financial-crimes investigator who has spent years laundering her own past into a spotless identity, is pulled back into the field when a voiceprint match unlocks a server in Singapore containing proof that a sanctioned oligarch's fortune is being cleaned through the very summit she's assigned to police. Teaming with Elias Vane, a disgraced interpol analyst whose voice was cloned for the breach, Hazel must smuggle the evidence past three governments while an assassin named Corvus closes in, forcing her to choose between burning her fabricated life to testify or letting the truth die. In the end, Hazel sacrifices her clean identity — surrendering her real name and criminal record to the tribunal — but exposes the network, and she and Elias walk away stateless, unbanked, and finally honest, together.
about_author: Marguerite Brightwater is a former compliance officer who spent a decade tracing money through shell companies before turning to fiction. She writes from a different city every year, keeping one suitcase packed out of habit.

chapters.title: The Go-Bag
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. In London, Hazel audits legitimate accounts by day while maintaining a forged identity and a packed go-bag by night, revealing fragments of her buried criminal past. When her supervisor assigns her security vetting for the Geneva Financial Summit, the routine feels like a trap closing. Emotional beat: the exhaustion of living a polished lie.

chapters.title: Voiceprint
chapters.summary: Elias's POV. In Singapore, disgraced analyst Elias Vane discovers his own voice has been cloned to unlock a shadow server holding ledgers tying the Volkov fortune to summit banks. Before he can copy it, someone burns his safehouse. Emotional beat: violation — your own voice used against you.

chapters.title: The Match
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. Running biometric sweeps on summit personnel, Hazel flags Elias's cloned voiceprint as an anomaly and requests extradition-style cooperation. Their first video call crackles with mutual suspicion; each recognizes a fellow faker. Emotional beat: two liars measuring each other.

chapters.title: Corvus
chapters.summary: Assassin POV (unnamed). A contract killer codenamed Corvus receives three names: Vane, Zhou, and the server's unknown architect. Cold, procedural chapters establish the methodical threat. Emotional beat: dread delivered without heat.

chapters.title: Clean Money
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. Hazel traces the laundered funds into accounts held by summit delegates themselves, realizing the conference meant to police dirty money is its washing machine. Her report is quashed within hours by someone above her. Emotional beat: institutional betrayal.

chapters.title: Runway
chapters.summary: Elias's POV. Fleeing Singapore on forged papers, Elias contacts Hazel directly, offering the server's location in exchange for protection. She must decide whether harboring him torches her career or saves the case. Emotional beat: the first leap of trust.

chapters.title: Istanbul Layover
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. The two meet in Istanbul to plan extraction of the ledger; a surveillance tail forces an improvised escape through the Grand Bazaar. They work together seamlessly and both notice. Emotional beat: reluctant chemistry under pressure.

chapters.title: The Architect
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. Decrypted metadata reveals the server's builder: a ghost from Hazel's criminal past who once forged her new identity. If he testifies, he exposes her too. Emotional beat: the past demanding interest.

chapters.title: Three Governments
chapters.summary: Elias's POV. British, Swiss, and Singaporean authorities all claim jurisdiction over the evidence — meaning all three want it buried or owned. Elias maps which officials are compromised and finds the rot reaches the summit's organizing committee. Emotional beat: nowhere safe to hand the truth.

chapters.title: Safehouse
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. Hiding in a Zurich safehouse, Hazel and Elias wait out a manhunt and, over cheap wine, trade their real histories — hers criminal, his professional disgrace. Intimacy deepens even as Corvus narrows the search. Emotional beat: love as risk assessment failing beautifully.

chapters.title: Compromise
chapters.summary: Corvus POV. Corvus locates the safehouse not through force but by buying Hazel's old file from her original forger. He waits rather than strikes, reporting back that Zhou's identity is fabricated — leverage someone above him wants alive. Emotional beat: patience as menace.

chapters.title: The Offer
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. A summit fixer offers Hazel full immunity and a new identity in exchange for the ledger and silence about the delegates' accounts. The price: Elias takes the fall alone. Emotional beat: duty dressed up as mercy.

chapters.title: Refusal
chapters.summary: Elias's POV. Elias learns of the offer and tries to take it himself, secretly negotiating his surrender to protect Hazel. She intercepts the handoff; their first real fight erupts — each trying to be the other's sacrifice. Emotional beat: love against duty, head-on.

chapters.title: Burn Notice
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. Refusing the deal, Hazel watches her own credentials revoked remotely; her bank accounts freeze mid-transaction, her flat access dies, her legend collapses in real time. Stripped of the clean life, she feels, strangely, lighter. Emotional beat: liberation inside catastrophe.

chapters.title: The Forger's Testimony
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Hazel and Elias reach the architect in Lyon, persuading him to authenticate the ledger — but Corvus arrives simultaneously. A brutal close-quarters escape costs the architect a gunshot wound and them their transport. Emotional beat: the past fighting for its life alongside them.

chapters.title: Corvus Unmasked
chapters.summary: Corvus POV. On the trail, Corvus recognizes Hazel's tradecraft — they trained in the same syndicate years ago. The hunt becomes personal, almost nostalgic, and Corvus hesitates for the first time. Emotional beat: the assassin's mirror.

chapters.title: Summit Eve
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. With the summit convening at dawn, the trio has authentication but no channel: every official route is compromised. Hazel proposes broadcasting the ledger during the opening plenary using the summit's own verification systems — the voiceprint Elias's clone was built to defeat. Emotional beat: desperate audacity.

chapters.title: Infiltration
chapters.summary: Elias's POV. Posing as delegation staff, they penetrate the Geneva venue; Corvus, now off-leash from his employers, lets them in — wanting the broadcast to happen so his former masters burn too. Tense cat-and-mouse through security checkpoints. Emotional beat: enemies aligned by shared wounds.

chapters.title: The Plenary
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. During the opening session, Hazel uses her real voice — the one matching her original criminal record — to authenticate the ledger live before delegates and cameras. Chaos erupts; Corvus appears in the gallery, rifle case in hand, then simply walks out. Emotional beat: the lie burned as fuel for the truth.

chapters.title: Aftermath
chapters.summary: Elias's POV. Governments scramble; resignations cascade; Hazel surrenders voluntarily, giving her true name and record to the tribunal in exchange for testimony immunity. Elias waits outside the hearing room every day. Emotional beat: accountability as rebirth.

chapters.title: Stateless
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. Months later, Hazel — no longer Zhou, not yet anyone else — meets Elias at a border town with no extradition treaty. Both unbanked, both free, they open a small consultancy helping whistleblowers move safely. Emotional beat: belonging found outside identity.

chapters.title: The Double Contact
chapters.summary: Coda, alternating brief POVs. A final transmission shows the network rebuilding elsewhere — and two voices, Hazel's and Elias's, now deliberately overlapping on one line, unlocking a new server together. Corvus, retired, reads about it and smiles. Emotional beat: the choice to keep touching danger, doubled.
